title: Aireloom Tight Top Extra Firm Mattress
descriptionHtml:
The Aireloom Tight Top Extra Firm Mattress is built for sleepers who want uncompromising support with a refined, luxury feel. Designed for back and stomach sleepers, this mattress delivers a stable, supportive surface that keeps your spine aligned throughout the night.

Handcrafted in California, every layer is selected to balance durability, breathability, and comfort. Natural materials like silk and wool work with an advanced TENCEL knit surface to regulate temperature and keep the sleep environment comfortable.

At the core of the mattress is the Aireloom Lift, a patented design that creates a natural air chamber between the support system and comfort layers. This allows the mattress to respond more precisely to your body while promoting continuous airflow.

The result is a mattress that feels supportive without being rigid, breathable without sacrificing structure, and built to perform night after night.

Key features

  • Extra firm feel ideal for back and stomach sleepers
  • Tight top design creates a flat and stable sleep surface
  • Aireloom Lift enhances airflow and adaptive support
  • Silk and wool fibers help regulate temperature naturally
  • TENCEL knit cover promotes breathability and moisture control
  • Individually wrapped coils reduce motion and improve support

Construction and materials

This mattress is built with a layered combination of natural fibers and advanced comfort materials to deliver long term support and durability.

The surface features a breathable TENCEL knit cover designed to promote airflow and moisture regulation. Beneath that, silk and wool fibers provide natural temperature control and a more balanced sleep environment.

Multiple layers of high performance foams work together to create the extra firm feel while still allowing slight contouring to the body. Cooling memory foam helps dissipate heat while adapting to pressure points.

The support system uses individually wrapped coils that respond independently to movement, helping reduce motion transfer while maintaining consistent support across the mattress.

The surface features a breathable TENCEL knit cover designed to promote airflow and moisture control. Beneath that, silk and wool fibers help regulate temperature and create a balanced sleep environment.

The Luxetop design introduces a deeper comfort profile, creating a more substantial and immersive feel.

A defining feature of this model is the dual micro coil system integrated into the comfort layers. This system allows the mattress to adapt to pressure points with greater precision while improving airflow throughout the mattress.

Natural latex is layered throughout the comfort system, providing responsive support and durability. Its open cell structure enhances breathability and helps maintain consistent comfort.

Additional plush comfort layers provide cushioning and pressure relief, while supportive layers help maintain structure and alignment.

The support system uses individually wrapped coils that respond independently, reducing motion transfer while maintaining consistent support across the mattress.
